import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# Suppress warnings
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Identify feature columns (excluding Id and target)
train_features = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
test_features = [col for col in test_df.columns if col not in ["Id"]]

# Separate features and target
X_train = train_df[train_features]
y_train = train_df["Cover_Type"]
X_test = test_df[test_features]
test_ids = test_df["Id"]

# Split training data into train/validation (hold-out split)
# Use 80/20 split for validation
val_size = int(0.2 * len(X_train))
val_mask = np.random.RandomState(42).choice(len(X_train), size=val_size, replace=False)
X_train_valid = X_train.iloc[val_mask]
y_train_valid = y_train.iloc[val_mask]
X_val = X_train.iloc[~val_mask]
y_val = y_train.iloc[~val_mask]

print(f"Training set after split: {X_train_valid.shape[0]} samples")
print(f"Validation set: {X_val.shape[0]} samples")

# Train model on training subset only (never see validation)
print("Training RandomForest model...")
model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    max_depth=30,
    min_samples_split=5,
    min_samples_leaf=2,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=0,
)

# Fit only on training data, not validation
model.fit(X_train_valid, y_train_valid)

# Evaluate on validation set (hold-out test)
print("Evaluating on validation set...")
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
print("Generating predictions on test set...")
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
print("Creating submission file...")
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": y_test_pred})

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Save to correct location
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")

# Final validation
print("\n=== Final Summary ===")
print(f"Training rows: {train_df.shape[0]}")
print(f"Test rows: {test_df.shape[0]}")
print(f"Validation Accuracy (hold-out): {val_accuracy:.6f}")
print(f"Submission file ready: ./submission/submission.csv")
